'''Fratch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], Fratch also shared the knowledge of slicing with others.
